title: LVIS Skill Package Manifest
description: The plugin.json of a standalone skill package distributed through the LVIS marketplace. The package is a directory holding this manifest next to SKILL.md. The skill itself — what SKILL.md's front matter declares — is described once, in $defs/skillComponent, and that same definition governs a skill bundled inside an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 plugin through the manifest's skills[] directory declarations. The package manifest reuses the component's fields by $ref, so the standalone path and the bundled path cannot drift apart. This SDK owns the schema; the LVIS host never loads it, and the marketplace validates against a byte-identical snapshot of it.

$schema.description: Schema URI used to classify skill packages. Pinned to this schema's $id.

name.description: Human-readable skill name shown in the catalog. Distinct from the component name, which is the slug.

description.description: Short human-readable summary shown on the catalog card. Bounded tighter than the component description, which may run to the Agent Skills ceiling.

skillComponent.title: LVIS Skill Component
skillComponent.description: The YAML front matter of a SKILL.md file (Agent Skills specification, as adopted by Agent Plugins 1.0.0) plus the LVIS keyword triggers. One definition for both delivery paths: the SKILL.md at the root of a standalone skill package, and the SKILL.md inside every directory a plugin manifest declares under skills[].

name.description: Skill slug. Must equal the directory name the SKILL.md lives in; for a standalone package it is also the marketplace slug and install directory name. The charset is the host's (`SKILL_NAME_ALLOWLIST`): the slug becomes a path segment under the skills directory, so a name must be path-safe. The 64-character ceiling is this schema's own bound, keeping the slug a viable path segment on every target filesystem; the host enforces no length of its own. Beyond those two the spelling is the author's — case, digits, underscores and hyphens are all theirs to choose.

description.description: Short human-readable summary of what the skill does and when to use it

license.description: License name or a reference to a bundled license file

compatibility.description: Environment requirements such as intended products, system packages, or network access

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value map for additional properties; the Agent Skills specification assigns no shape to the values

allowed-tools.description: Space-delimited list of tools the skill is pre-approved to use
